YES: building a model over a strict subset of `n.snapshots` and then calling `solve_model(extra_functionality=...)` passes the full network snapshot index to `_call_extra_functionality`. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` returns that index unchanged, so the callback receives more snapshots than the model was built over.
YES
